name: Gushiken Takahiro
source: A rising judo star who is sent back in time to feudal Japan. The village he arrives in is populated with both humans and kitsune, with the former being distrustful of the latter. While trying to get back to his own time, Takahiro attempts to improve the tense relationship between the two groups.
